title: Sloth holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='4' y='68' width='92' height='9' rx='4' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='4' y='68' width='92' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#B07A45'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='20' ry='18' fill='#A08858'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='14' ry='13' fill='#C8B078'/>
  <!-- arms reaching branch -->
  <path d='M36 48 Q30 60 34 70' stroke='#8F7748' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M64 48 Q70 60 66 70' stroke='#8F7748' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claws on branch -->
  <rect x='30' y='67' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8DCA8'/>
  <rect x='36' y='67' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8DCA8'/>
  <rect x='62' y='67' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8DCA8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='67' width='4' height='6' rx='2' fill='#E8DCA8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='16' fill='#C8B078'/>
  <!-- face mask light -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#F0E6C0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='32' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#6B5838'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#6B5838'/>

  <circle cx='44' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='32' r='1.8' fill='#1A1A1A'/>
  <circle cx='44.6' cy='31.4' r='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56.6' cy='31.4' r='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#4A3A22'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 42 Q50 45 54 42' stroke='#4A3A22' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#A08858'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='27' r='3.5' fill='#A08858'/>
  <!-- heart held in front -->
  <path d='M50 76 C42 68 34 72 36 78 C38 84 50 90 50 90 C50 90 62 84 64 78 C66 72 58 68 50 76 Z' fill='#E8455A'/>
  <path d='M50 76 C46 72 41 72 39 75' stroke='#FF8FA0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little paws holding heart -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#8F7748'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#8F7748'/>
</svg>
